name: embeddings
description: Provider-agnostic text embeddings (OpenAI, Mistral, Gemini, Voyage, Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible host) and similarity ranking

nodes.title: Embed texts
nodes.description: Embed texts with the configured provider; data[] holds {index, embedding} with index pointing into input

model.description: Embedding model (default: EMBEDDINGS_MODEL, else the provider's default)

dimensions.description: Shorter vectors: OpenAI, Gemini and Ollama name it dimensions

output_dimension.description: Shorter vectors: Voyage and Mistral name it output_dimension

input_type.description: Voyage only: embed as a search query or a document

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Rank by similarity
nodes.description: Semantic search over a short list: embeds the query and documents and returns the top_k most similar documents with cosine scores

model.description: Embedding model (default: EMBEDDINGS_MODEL, else the provider's default)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
